title: LLM RL Post-Training Architecture (PPO vs. GRPO, Colocated veRL HybridEngine vs. Disaggregated Async Rollout) Benchmark

tiers.name: Tier 1: 4-Model PPO (`36Ψ` Memory) + Naive HuggingFace `generate()` + Disk Weight Sync (`95s` Stall)
tiers.verdict: Anti-Pattern: Critic model doubles memory (`36Ψ`); disk weight sync & long-tail 32K rollouts waste 64.2% of GPUs

tiers.name: Tier 2: Critic-Free GRPO (`20Ψ`) + Colocated veRL 3D-HybridEngine (Fast `1.8s` Reshard, Sync 32K Barrier)
tiers.verdict: Great for <=8K uniform rollouts (`1.8s` in-memory reshard), but 127 GPUs wait on the single longest 32K chain!

tiers.name: Tier 3: Static 50/50 Disaggregated Trainer & Rollout Pools (Over-RDMA Weight Broadcast, Idle Pool Alternating)
tiers.verdict: Decouples TP/PP layouts, but static 1-step synchronous barrier still idles Trainer while Rollout finishes

tiers.name: Tier 4: GRPO + FP8 SGLang/vLLM Rollout + Partial Rollout Continuation (Bounded Staleness k=1) + Sequence Packing
tiers.verdict: Recommended: 74s RL step (6.69x faster vs. Tier 1), 1.6s weight sync, 5.8% bubble & -85.0% cost per 1K steps
